# `oaap app address`

an instance's own public hostname and its aliases (RFC-0009, RFC-0018).

**Root:** needs `sudo`.

## Usage

```sh
oaap app address [--tenant INSTANCE_TENANT]
                        {show,set,remove,alias-add,alias-remove} name
                        [hostname]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `action` | what to do -- see Actions below |
| `name` | -- |
| `hostname` | public hostname of its own, e.g. hub.example.org; with alias-add/alias-remove, the alias name |
| `--tenant INSTANCE_TENANT` | tenant label: read the instance as a NAME inside this tenant (also: <tenant>/<name>) |

## Actions

Whether an action needs `sudo` is read from the rule the node enforces, with the other arguments left out (e.g. `node care` reads, `node care measure` needs `sudo`).

| Action | Needs `sudo` |
|---|---|
| `show` | yes |
| `set` | yes |
| `remove` | yes |
| `alias-add` | yes |
| `alias-remove` | yes |
